Select and normalize cohort identifiers

Source: R/duckdb_backend.R
select_cohort_ids.Rd

Resolves exactly one direct-ID, SQL, R-function, ICD, named-cohort, or no-filter request through the canonical DuckDB selection engine. Returned identifiers are character-normalized and validated against the configured source hierarchy. Diagnostics report counts only and never print values.

Usage

select_cohort_ids(
  src_name,
  icd_filter_path = NULL,
  cohort_sql = NULL,
  setup_sql = NULL,
  cohort_fn = NULL,
  direct_ids_path = NULL,
  cohort = NULL,
  no_filter = FALSE,
  key = NULL,
  import_scope = NULL,
  allow_unmatched_ids = FALSE,
  out_csv = NULL,
  base_dir = NULL,
  raw_data_root = NULL,
  window_sql = NULL,
  window_fn = NULL
)

Arguments

src_name

Registered source name.

icd_filter_path

ICD-code CSV or RDS file with an icd_code column and an icd_version column (9 or 10). icd_version is required for MIMIC-IV and eICU; for MIMIC-III it may be omitted (ICD-9 is assumed) and ICD-10 rows are excluded. A code matches only in its stated version.

cohort_sql

Final selection query; use setup_sql for dependencies.

setup_sql

Optional ordered SQL statements or files.

cohort_fn

Function or function name returning identifiers.

direct_ids_path

CSV, CSV.GZ, Parquet, or RDS identifier file.

cohort

Bundled named cohort.

no_filter

Select the whole available source.

key

Explicit configured hierarchy key.

import_scope

Patient, hospital, ICU, or configured hierarchy key.

allow_unmatched_ids

Permit a partially unmatched selection when at least one identifier matches.

out_csv

Optional atomic one-column identifier export.

base_dir

Project root.

raw_data_root

Optional parent of the source-specific raw directory.

window_sql, window_fn

Optional hierarchy builder override.

Value

An object of class ehr_selection_plan. Printing it shows the route, keys, scope and counts; the identifiers themselves are in $values.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plan <- select_cohort_ids("mimic_iv_demo", cohort = "scid")
plan               # route, keys, scope and counts
head(plan$values)  # the selected identifiers
} # }
